proposals.evidence: The full śuṣka article explicitly includes the expanded Prakrit sukkhāṇa adjective and Assamese xukān/śukān, in addition to simple sukkha. This n-bearing regional dry adjective explains the entire hukna/hukana stem; the initial h corresponds to the eastern x/s series and the ending vowel is retained. The link identifies that expanded dry family and leaves regional contact transmission open; hukase and other additional verbal suffixes are not silently stripped.
